chapter.title: Scheduling
chapter.para: JetOS schedules at two levels: the module executes the slots of the schedule, which gives the processor to the partitions in turn, and inside a partition its own scheduler chooses its process. The requirements on the processes are in the chapter "Processes".

section.para: JetOS shall execute the schedule of the module as an endless series of major frames, each the same ordered list of slots, the first one beginning when the schedule starts.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The cyclic schedule is the ARINC 653 time partitioning.

section.para: JetOS shall, in a partition slot, run only the partition of the slot; in a spare slot, nothing; in a monitor slot, the monitor, and in a GDB slot the GDB server, if configured.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The time of each partition is fixed in advance.

section.para: JetOS shall end a slot and begin the next one, switching to its partition, at the end of the duration of the slot, within one period of the timer tick, whatever the partition does.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A partition cannot keep the processor longer than its slot, so the others always get their time.

section.para: JetOS shall save the context of a partition at the end of its slot, and resume it, at the point where it was interrupted, at the start of its next slot, unless the partition was restarted in the meantime.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A partition does not notice the slots of the others.

section.para: JetOS shall handle the events of a partition (time-outs, the release of periodic processes, deadlines, delayed starts and messages for its ports) in the partition, in its own context.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Kernel work for one partition must not run in the time that belongs to another.

section.para: JetOS shall start the periodic processes of a partition at the start of a slot of that partition that is marked as starting periodic processing.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Periodic processing starts at known points of the schedule.

section.para: JetOS shall let a partition idle, waiting for events, when none of its processes can run.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The partition has nothing to execute, and nothing else may run in its slot.

section.para: JetOS shall start the schedule again from the first slot of a new major frame, with every partition started afresh, when the module restarts.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A module restart has to put every partition in a known state.
